rationale: The Chief is best positioned to write a narrow opinion recognizing a self-executing constitutional entitlement to just compensation while remanding or reserving sovereign-immunity/vehicle questions. Alito is likely to dissent on the cause-of-action/immunity distinction, with possible concurrences from Thomas or Gorsuch (and perhaps Barrett) pressing a more categorical view that the Takings Clause itself is judicially enforceable without statutory intermediation.
